description.value: The Farmer's Daughter is a fromagerie, bistro, and wine bar on Sidney's main Beacon Avenue, specializing in over 150 artisan and farmhouse cheeses cut to order alongside a curated wine selection. The shop offers cheese and wine flights with tasting notes, a small plates menu, and grazing platters and picnic boxes to go. It's an excellent resupply stop for touring cyclists looking for high-quality charcuterie, cheese, or a ready-made picnic on the Saanich Peninsula.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 35m; rack (4 spaces) at 64m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-established fromagerie and bistro on Sidney's main street; the picnic box and to-go offerings make it a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists passing through the Saanich Peninsula.
